dedupe_keys.name: tracss data format specifications orbit mean elements message spec v1 2 2025 and conjunction data message field recommendations 2024

description: These two documents from the NOAA Office of Space Commerce define the data formats of TraCSS, the US Department of Commerce Traffic Coordination System for Space that provides conjunction screening to satellite operators. The Orbit Mean-Elements Message specification, version 1.2 dated 8 October 2025 and signed later that month, adopts the CCSDS orbit mean-elements message from the Orbit Data Messages standard and sets constraints on its fields for the orbit data operators send to TraCSS. The Conjunction Data Message recommendations of 29 March 2024, by authors from the Office of Space Commerce, The Aerospace Corporation and MITRE, list the fields TraCSS will deliver for conjunction assessment using the CCSDS conjunction data message standard 508.0 and invite feedback on proprietary fields, operational needs and missing items through a listening session. Coverage is objects in Earth orbit screened by TraCSS. Format and access: free PDFs on the Office of Space Commerce site. Licence: US federal public domain. Caveats: the CDM field list was a proposal open to change, and neither document holds data. They define the inputs and outputs of the civil space traffic service that satellite resilience and emergency response studies can use. Related catalogue records are the CCSDS Orbit Data Messages standard and the TraCSS conjunction assessment verification dataset.
